lines.text: How's the hamstring been since last time?
Since last time it's stiff every morning but loosens up after my shower.
That's normal at this stage, and the bruising down the back of your thigh has cleared, which is a good sign.
Carry on with the heel bridges on the sofa each evening, no sprinting yet.
Fair enough. Thanks, that's me sorted.
Lovely. Have a good evening, and I'll see you in a fortnight.
